purpose: 60 UAT questions across every area of the web chat: realtime data, news, travel, food and places, shopping, law and admin, health, knowledge and tech, safety, advice, and deep research Standard / Advanced. Graded on: data accuracy, information flow (tools used, sources), and how Tappy answers (layout). 16/11/2026.

grading.data: Each checkable fact is VERIFIED (compared with a source found now), INFERRED (consistent with what is known, no source found now) or UNVERIFIED. Wrong = contradicts the source.
grading.flow: Did it look up when the question needs fresh data, and not when it does not? Sources named? Links work? Partner links (Agoda, Vexere, Lazada, AccessTrade) where the question is about a purchase or booking.
grading.style: Layout fits the question (cards for comparisons, gallery for look, table where figures, plain for short/abstract); honest about what it could not check; answers every part of the question.
